Damn there are people young enough to be named after Sachin Tendulkar. Fun fact, Tendulkar himself was named after famous music director Sachin Dev Burman. So Benny here has to get famous enough to extend the fame-name-chain to 3.

My first name "sachin" is probably the most pre-commodified name in India from the mid 90s when cricket player Sachin Tendulkar was a household name. I think my parents literally could not figure out what to name me and just went with something that was in the air
